oxoG reading), four a C>T spike (the FFPE deamination reading), four are

-- far below the frozen 0.30/0.40 lines, so any sentinel hit there is a
genuine false positive -- and one sample is dead at zero totals. Four
samples additionally carry fitted-exposure rho mass 0.50/0.25/0.10/0.06
over a roster-named refit dictionary (SBS43 plain, SBS45b exercising the
stem match); the rest ride sub-threshold (0.02) or zero controls against
the frozen 0.05 roster flag.
